resolved_issues: Use PostgreSQL dialect-rendered shortened constraint names when comparing FK definitions.
PostgreSQL 18 reports RESTRICT DELETE as SQLSTATE 23001 and numeric overflow as DBAPI error 22003; tests assert actual appropriate errors.
DELETE RESTRICT tests select a genuinely referenced user, since the schema permits deleting unreferenced users.
Source-association corruption fixture disables the primary-contact flag before moving the contact, avoiding an unrelated valid partial-unique rejection.
Integrity JSON comparison distinguishes booleans from numerically equal integers instead of Python False == 0.
